title: Warmed Irish Stew
description: A hearty, comforting stew originating from Ireland, made with lamb and root vegetables.
instructions: Season the lamb with salt and pepper.
In a large Dutch oven, brown the lamb in a little bit of oil over medium-high heat.
Remove the lamb from the pot and set it aside.
Add the chopped onions to the pot and cook until they're softened.
Add the chopped carrots and potatoes to the pot and cook for a few minutes.
Add the lamb back to the pot, along with the Guinness and Worcestershire Sauce.
Bring the stew to a simmer, then cover the pot and transfer it to the preheated oven.
Braise the stew for 2-3 hours, or until the lamb is tender.
Serve the stew hot, garnished with fresh herbs if desired.
